scope: Recorded per-target/cast outcomes only; no rerun, tuning, trajectory reconstruction, counterfactual miss reason or population win-rate inference. Fire-to-hit target distances use explicit fire origin and hit location. HP loss can be clipped by remaining HP/shield. No terrain impact/end-of-flight telemetry is present.
